title: Living with debt
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why do people sometimes continue borrowing even when they know debt is becoming a problem?
If you had to choose between paying off debt quickly and keeping more money for daily life, how would you decide?
Do you think schools should teach teenagers how loans, credit cards, and interest work?
When does borrowing money make sense, and when does it become irresponsible?
Imagine a close friend is falling behind on payments. What practical advice would you give them?
